title: Power Apps Christmas Calendar
short_desc: A digital Christmas calendar for colleagues, built in Power Apps. A new door opens each day in December with a quiz or a small game.
problem: I wanted to lift spirits and bring colleagues together in December.
built: Each of the 24 doors unlocks on its own date, and behind each one is a quiz question or a mini-game.
result: A December calendar for colleagues with a new quiz or game each day.
tech_notes: Each door checks the date on the user's device and stays locked until its day. There are 24 screens, each with its own quiz or mini-game, built in Power Apps.
